title: vec purge-orphan response (v1.0.69)
description: Response shape of `sqlite-graphrag vec purge-orphan --yes --json`. Added in v1.0.69 as part of G39. Purges orphans from vec_memories, vec_entities, and vec_chunks in a single transaction. Corrected by GAP-SG-271, which ran the command and validated the real envelope for the first time: the document declared a nested `purged` object and a `namespace` string that `VecPurgeOrphanResponse` in src/commands/vec.rs has never serialized, enumerated two `action` values none of its three call sites writes, and omitted the four flat counters it always emits. Under `additionalProperties: false` that rejected every real answer.

truncated.description: GAP-SG-142: raised by the agent-native surface whenever it removed data from this envelope.

count.description: GAP-SG-142: emitted under --count-only, which replaces the payload. See agent-surface.schema.json#/$defs/CountOnlyEnvelope.

action.description: `purged_orphan` after rows were deleted, `purge_orphan_dry_run` under --dry-run, and `purge_orphan` when no memory embedding table exists at all, which short-circuits before any counting

deleted.description: Rows deleted from the active memory embedding table. Always 0 on the dry-run and short-circuit paths.

deleted_entities.description: Rows deleted from vec_entities (G39). Always 0 on the dry-run and short-circuit paths.

deleted_chunks.description: Rows deleted from vec_chunks (G39). Always 0 on the dry-run and short-circuit paths.

dry_run.description: True when nothing was written, so the counters above describe an empty operation rather than the rows that WOULD be deleted
